mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; amikacin-induced renal impairment increases ciprofloxacin accumulation, while fluoroquinolones may potentiate aminoglycoside ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, use lowest effective doses, monitor for ototoxicity symptoms (tinnitus, hearing loss), and consider alternatives if possible.
